findings.summary: Three text runs fall just under the 4.5:1 AA contrast for normal text over the white page: the left panel's explanatory paragraph ('a write or a recursive removal here fails in the kernel ...', lines 79-82) and the 'refused' legend (line 99) render in GREY #7a7a7a at 4.29:1, and the 'granted' legend (line 100) renders in GREEN #2e8b57 at 4.25:1. All three are 14pt, below the large-text exemption, so 4.5:1 applies and these are the only marks in the figure that miss it. The left paragraph is the least contrasty text in the figure although it carries the left side's whole explanation (why a refusal happens at the kernel regardless of enumeration), so a reader's eye can skip it in favour of the four dark list entries above it. It is non-blocking because 4.25:1 is still comfortably legible and the dashed/solid arrow distinction survives. Remedy, if taken: draw those runs in BODY #3f3f3f (10.53:1) and use GREEN_DARK #1f5c3a (7.92:1) for the 'granted' legend (or keep GREEN #2e8b57 for the arrow strokes alone, which need only 3:1).

rubric_items.contrast: defect - headings 14.16:1, list entries and the closing note 10.53:1, right-column entries 7.92:1, but the left panel's explanatory paragraph and the 'refused' legend sit at 4.29:1 and the 'granted' legend at 4.25:1 against white, just under the 4.5:1 AA normal-text threshold; all four remain readable and clear the 3:1 bar for non-text, so nothing is lost to a reader.
rubric_items.data_ink: pass - no plotted quantity exists to weigh, and the ink is all entry text, arrows and borders; the only solid fill is the centre node that marks the subject, drawn beneath its white label.
rubric_items.decoration: pass - transparent canvas, no gradient, no background fill, no shading or drop shadow; the two panel outlines are 1.3pt strokes and the arrows are plain dashes.
rubric_items.label_collision: pass - ink bounding box (59,37)-(1340,655) sits inside the 1400x720 canvas with at least 59px at the left, 60px right, 37px top and 65px bottom; no label touches another label, an arrow, a panel border or the closing note.
rubric_items.legibility: pass - one 1400x720 schematic reads at a glance: two headed columns, a filled centre node, four dashed arrows to the refusals and four solid arrows to the grants; every word is legible at page scale.
rubric_items.table_form: pass - the content is a relation, not a table: one fence node issuing two outcomes, refused and granted, which the paired arrow sets carry and a two-column table would not.
